comparison.objective: Tilt a chassis so a dropped screw slides out, then retrieve it magnetically.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual chassis holding, gravity-assisted recovery, and magnetic tool use.
comparison.success_condition: Screw reaches the parts dish, tool is returned, chassis reset, and arms withdrawn; numeric tiers are absent.
comparison.reason: Recovering loose hardware does not set or lock a screw-controlled mechanism.
